name: OODS Forge — Cursor (stdio)
summary: Connect Cursor to the OODS Forge runtime bundle through the stdio adapter.

env.MCP_EXTRA_TOOLS: comma-separated on-demand tools to add to the default surface, for example a11y.scan,diag.snapshot
env.OODS_NODE_PATH: absolute path of the Node binary the adapter should start the server with; default: the Node running the adapter

notes: Replace /path/to/forge-runtime with the directory you extracted forge-runtime.tar.gz into; the path must be absolute.
Node 20.11.1 or newer must be on the PATH as node, or set OODS_NODE_PATH.
The adapter starts the bundled native server itself; nothing else needs to be built, installed or running.
Default surface: 19 tools. MCP_TOOLSET=all advertises all 24.
Cursor reads the file on start; reload the window after saving.
